# KaTeX 0.17.0

Vendored from the npm release tarball recorded in lock.json; SHA-512 verified
before extraction. No npm or Node runtime/build dependency is required.
`katex.mjs` and LICENSE are unchanged. `katex.css` is dist/katex.min.css with
font sources reduced to WOFF2 and embedded as data URLs, plus Roclet overflow
and fallback rules. This same stylesheet makes HTML reports self-contained.
The lock records SHA-256 hashes of these delivered files.

Upstream: https://katex.org/ — MIT, see LICENSE.
